summary: Ran backend regression and direct lifecycle probes plus Expo web preview at 390x844. Core APIs, staff urgent alert/detail, assignment, queue navigation, hotspot map, and no-error UI checks passed.

critical.issue: Accepts status=Resolved without verification_image_base64 and sets verified_at; direct API clients can close reports without cleanup evidence, contrary to guarded resolve requirement.

action_items: Enforce verification_image_base64 presence/non-empty when PATCH status is Resolved; return a 4xx otherwise.
Consider preventing evidence from being added after a report is already Resolved, or define an explicit correction workflow.

Align frontend API environment variable with the deployment contract (source currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while instructions specify EXPO_BACKEND_URL), or document the public variable consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend update_report unconditionally sets verified_at for Resolved and does not validate evidence.
Frontend resolves safely in UI, but client-side guarding alone does not protect the API.
Frontend API constant uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because that key exists in frontend/.env.

success_rate.backend: 100% regression (2/2); evidence guard failed (0/1 expected rejection)
success_rate.frontend: 100% tested flows (staff load, alert/detail, assignment, map, queue, no fatal errors)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ reports during existing regression and edge probing; no DELETE endpoint exists, so they remain in the database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo preview at 390x844 loaded and rendered staff overview, urgent alert, detail actions, hotspot map, and priority queue. Assignment PATCH succeeded. No mocked APIs used.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: POST any report, then PATCH /api/reports/{id} with {"status":"Resolved"}; response is 200 with status Resolved, verified_at populated, and no verification_image_base64. Root cause is server.py update_report only adds verified_at and lacks a required-evidence check. UI guard in ReportDetail does not cover direct API callers.
